bias.label: Leaning up while above 4,106; stalling at 4,135 before CPI

event: US October CPI, today Tue 10 Nov 15:30 SAST. US PPI Fri 13 Nov 15:30 SAST.

bullets.title: Quiet Asia open
bullets.text: Spot gold was about 4,134 at 03:12 SAST, down about 5 in early trade after Monday's jump (Kitco).

bullets.title: Back at 4,135
bullets.text: Price slipped back to Monday morning's 4,135 high after topping at 4,149, so this level is now the line in the sand (Kitco).

bullets.title: Hike odds weigh
bullets.text: A FXStreet headline says gold fell under 4,150 as rising Fed hike bets outweighed US-Iran deal hopes; we could only read the headline, so details are UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Dollar still soft
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 101.69, down about 0.6% from Monday, which still supports gold (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Yields firm
bullets.text: The US 10-year yield is near 4.90%, and markets price about 81% odds of a December Fed hike, which can cap the rally (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: CPI decides today
bullets.text: October CPI lands at 15:30 SAST; a hot number can push gold under 4,106, a soft one can reopen 4,150-4,200 (Discovery Alert, MoneySafe).
